intro: Use this pounds to ounces conversion calculator to convert dry avoirdupois pounds (lb) into ounces (oz) for shipping labels, meat cuts, and baking batches. Comparing pounds vs oz, 1 international pound equals exactly 16 ounces—simply multiply pounds by 16 for total ounces, or convert decimal pounds to ounces for postal scales. Check common weights from 0.25 lb to 200 lb in the lookup table below.

mistakesAndEdgeCases.title: Dry Ounces (oz) vs. Fluid Ounces (fl oz) & Decimal Pounds to lb + oz
items: Pounds (lb) and ounces (oz) measure weight/mass (1 lb = 16 oz), whereas fluid ounces (fl oz) measure liquid volume. Only pure water weighs roughly 1.043 lb per 16 US fl oz; never convert lbs directly to fl oz without ingredient density.

To turn decimal pounds into whole pounds and ounces, keep the whole number and multiply only the decimal fraction by 16 (for example, 2.28 lb = 2 lb + 0.28 × 16 = 2 lb 4.48 oz). Precious-metal Troy pounds use 12 troy oz per lb t instead of 16.

faqs.question: How many ounces are in 1 pound?
faqs.answer: There are exactly 16 avoirdupois ounces in 1 pound (1 lb = 16 oz). Conversely, 1 ounce equals 0.0625 pounds.

faqs.question: How do you convert decimal pounds to ounces?
faqs.answer: Multiply the entire decimal pound value by 16 to get total ounces (for example, 2.5 lb × 16 = 40 oz). For pounds-and-ounces, keep the whole pounds and multiply only the decimal part by 16 (2.08 lb = 2 lb 1.28 oz).

faqs.question: Can you convert pounds (lbs) directly to fluid ounces (fl oz)?
faqs.answer: No—pounds measure dry weight while fluid ounces measure liquid volume. You need the substance's density to convert lbs to fl oz (16 US fl oz of water weighs ~1.043 lb, whereas oil is lighter and honey is heavier).
